note: Model registry for sim/tools/bench.mjs. One pinned host per model (provider + quantizations, no fallbacks). Pins other than Ripple's were chosen from the public OpenRouter endpoint list on 2026-11-15 (node sim/tools/bench.mjs --endpoints <model>) and have not been called yet. Thinking is turned off ("thinking": false) for every model that allows it, matching how Ripple runs; models that think anyway show up as cut-off replies on the scorecard, never as wrong answers. Prices are per million tokens at the pinned host, for cost estimates only. Entries with a 'backend' run through the locally authenticated CLI (sim/tools/cli_chat.mjs): no temperature control, reasoning effort recorded instead.
settings: Per-model settings, each optional; "defaults" fills the gaps (sim/tools/arena/model_settings.mjs). maxTokens: reply budget per live decision. programMaxTokens: reply budget for a program in --mode program. thinking: false asks the host to skip reasoning, true allows it, absent sends nothing (sent as OpenRouter reasoning.enabled; for other servers put their own switch in extraBody). reasoningMaxTokens: cap on reasoning when thinking is true. temperature: the same 0.7 for every model unless set. retry.truncated: extra attempts when a reply is cut off (default 0; the harness always allows one retry for an unusable reply). baseUrl + apiKeyEnv: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, key read from that environment variable or .env. price: dollars per million tokens, for cost estimates when the host reports none.

models.role: frontier via local Claude Code login; our system prompt replaces Claude Code's, no tools; temperature not settable
frontier via local Claude Code login
frontier via local Codex login; Codex agent instructions (~26k tokens) wrap our prompt (confound); temperature not settable

example: any OpenAI-compatible server. Start the stand-in with node sim/tools/arena/mock_openai.mjs --mode steady, then node sim/tools/bench.mjs --model local-mock --map factory. For a real server add apiKeyEnv (the name of the variable holding its key) and its thinking switch in extraBody.
